# Handoff Template

This file documents the 10-section structure of a handoff markdown.
The `/handoff` skill generates output following this shape — it does
NOT load this file at runtime. It exists only as a human-readable
reference.

```markdown
# {Title in Title Case}

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM ({TZ})
**Repo:** {repo name}
**Branch:** {git branch} (HEAD: {short SHA})
**Generated by:** /handoff [{verbatim user argument, or blank}]
**Lanjutan dari:** `.handoff/{previous handoff filename}` or `—`
**Plan terkait:** `path/to/plan.md` — fase {N}/{total} or `—`

---

## 1. Konteks Proyek
2-4 sentences explaining the project domain & stack so a fresh session
gets oriented without reading CLAUDE.md.

## 2. Yang Sudah Selesai di Sesi Ini  (SUDAH)
- Action verb + concrete object bullets.
- Cite commit SHAs and file paths inline.
- Mark whether verified/merged vs just written.

## 3. Yang Sedang Dikerjakan / Belum Selesai  (SEDANG)
- Mid-flight / WIP state not captured by git or the chain.
- Which file is half-edited, where you stopped, what's uncommitted.
- Mental context to restore.

(Or `—` if the session ended at a clean point.)

## 4. Blocker
- What blocks progress, internal (needs user decision) or external
  (waiting for review, credentials, API down).
- For each: what is needed to unblock.

(Or `—` if none.)

## 5. Apa yang Akan Dikerjakan di Sesi Berikutnya  (AKAN)
**Goal:** one sentence

- Step / area / decision

**Starting point:**
- Branch: ...
- Spec/plan to read first: ... (see also "Plan terkait" in header)

## 6. Pilihan & Keputusan User Lewat Brainstorming
| Pertanyaan | Pilihan User | Konsekuensi |
|---|---|---|
| ... | ... | ... |

(Or `—` if no choices were made this session.)

## 7. Artefak yang Dihasilkan
- **Spec:** path or `—`
- **Plan:** path or `—`
- **HEAD saat handoff:** short SHA (anchor)
- **Commits sesi ini:** N commits (base-SHA..head-SHA) or `—`
- **Per-fase:** "fase 2 selesai di SHA, fase 3 in-progress" or `—`
- **Files baru / diubah / dihapus:** ...

## 8. Anti-Patterns / Lessons Learned (CARRY FORWARD)
- ❌ JANGAN ... (reason)
- ✅ LAKUKAN ... (reason)

(Or `—` if none.)

## 9. Catatan Tambahan dari User
Verbatim from /handoff <args>, or `—`.

## 10. Hal-Hal Penting Lain untuk Sesi Berikutnya
- Environment, tooling, IP, credentials
- Open questions
- Surprising / hidden context
- Deadlines / freeze windows
```
